name: VibeCab
workflow: Capture ideas as BACKLOG or executable tasks as TODO
Fetch the project graph and task context
Preview and apply a dependency plan using its revision
Renew your claim; complete or release using its token

endpoints.description: List tasks without claim tokens or vectors
Atomic, retry-safe batch. Reuse request_id with identical content on retry. Dependencies may be batch keys or existing task UUIDs.

Full context, directed edges with rationale, graph revision, per-task direct blockers, ancestors, descendants, and prerequisite-first execution_layers. Layers are structural, not current claim eligibility.
Focused dependency analysis with related task context
Atomic replacement of prerequisites for selected tasks. Preview with dry_run=true; apply with false. Stale revision, cycles, cross-project edges, and edits to claimed/completed tasks are rejected.

changes.rationale: Why these tasks depend on one another

endpoints.description: Eligible tasks sorted by priority, creation time, ID
Atomically select and claim highest-priority eligible task. Returns {task:null} when no work is available.
Optional fields; include expected_version to reject stale edits. Direct lifecycle edits allow BACKLOG, TODO, CANCELED only. Claimed and completed tasks cannot be edited.
Deletes an unclaimed, unfinished task with no dependents
Most recent 100 events, including dependency rationale; no ownership tokens
Supply embeddings from your own model. Title/context edits invalidate stored embeddings.
Cosine-distance search within the same project, model and vector dimension. Lower distance is more similar. No external model calls.

rules.leases: 1..3600 seconds; renew before expiration. Tokens fence stale workers and are returned only when claiming.
rules.dependencies: task_id depends on depends_on. Every prerequisite must be DONE. CANCELED prerequisites still block work.
rules.conflicts: 409: refresh the relevant task/graph before deciding whether to retry.
rules.idempotency: Only batch capture provides persisted idempotency. Claim/complete/release are token-gated, not replay-idempotent.
